Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293266. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL ID, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
